objective: Run the four E2E gates (E1 submit-to-done, E2 crash-recovery, E3 retry-exhaustion, E4 unknown-id) against the fully wired app and produce gate evidence, locating any failure to a seam

files: app/main.py (app entry for restart fixture, read-only)
concepts: E2E gate design (happy + failure scenarios per seam)
app-restart test fixture for crash recovery

frozen_contracts.spec: POST /reports body {input: object} -> 202 {job_id: uuid} (422 on invalid body, error shape C6). GET /reports/{job_id} -> 200 {job_id, status, attempts, progress, result_ref, error, created_at} or 404 {error: {code: 'not_found', message}} for unknown/invalid uuid.

States queued, running, retry_wait, done, failed. Legal transitions: queued->running; running->retry_wait (attempt < 3, backoff 1s/4s/16s by attempt number); running->done; running->failed (attempt == 3); retry_wait->running; retry_wait->failed (attempt == 3). Crash recovery: any row with status running at startup transitions running->queued (recompute, idempotent per A-2); rows in retry_wait resume their schedule. attempts increments when leaving running toward retry_wait or failed; progress written by the worker between 0..100.

ReportWorkerPool (app/services/report_worker.py): start(session_factory), stop(), submit(job_id: str) -> None (no-op if already queued in pool); run_job(job_id) executes one job to terminal state honoring C3. Pool size fixed at 3. Callable synchronously from tests.

JobStore (app/services/job_store.py), methods on a session: create_job(input_payload: dict) -> ReportJob (status queued); get(job_id) -> ReportJob|None; transition(job_id, from_status, to_status, **fields) -> ReportJob, raises IllegalTransition on illegal C3 transition; recover_stale(now) -> list[ReportJob] (running rows, per C3 recovery).

Error shape for all new-endpoint errors: {error: {code: str, message: str}}. Codes: 'not_found' (GET unknown id), 'invalid_body' (422). Job-level failure stored as report_jobs.error = {code: 'generation_failed', message: <str(exc)>} text field.

allowed_dependencies.what: the seam-wired, consistency-verified system under test

non_goals: No production code changes — E2E defects are reported with seam location, not fixed here (T06 owns fixes; a re-entry loop is the replan path)
No new acceptance criteria — gates E1-E4 only, mapped to A2/A3/A4/A5/A6
implementation_constraints: Each gate is an independent test so a failing gate does not block the others from producing evidence
The crash-recovery gate needs an app-restart fixture: start app, pause a job mid-run, stop app, start app again, assert recovery
If the restart fixture proves unstable (see risk warning), checkpoint_and_split into per-gate subtasks before continuing

deliverables.what: E2E test suite for gates E1-E2
E2E test suite for gate E3

acceptance_tests.description: E1: POST /reports returns 202, the job reaches status 'done' with progress 100 and result_ref set, and GET returns those values
E2: a job left in status 'running' across an app restart is re-queued, recomputed exactly once (generator call count 1), and reaches status 'done'
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/e2e/test_reports_flow.py::test_crash_recovery_resume passes with generator call count asserted == 1

acceptance_tests.description: E3: a generator that always raises produces status 'failed', attempts 3, error set, and exactly 3 generator calls
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/e2e/test_retry.py::test_retry_exhaustion passes with call count asserted == 3

acceptance_tests.description: E4: GET /reports/{unknown} returns 404 with error.code 'not_found'; a malformed uuid also returns 404

failure_cases.scenario: an E2E gate fails while all leaf unit suites are green
failure_cases.expected_behavior: the failing gate, its seam (from the gate's covers field), and the test output are recorded in the checkpoint as a blocker of kind CORE_SEAM_BLOCKER or a gate_failure replan trigger; leaves are not re-executed

failure_cases.scenario: the same gate fails 3 consecutive re-runs
failure_cases.expected_behavior: the gate_failure trigger fires after 3 consecutive failed re-runs of the same test — replan-controller path (V1: stop + user decision with the structured stop-report)

handoff.notes: gate evidence is T08's input for A2/A3/A4/A5/A6 — verified_facts must state pass/fail per gate with test ids

warnings.detail: E2E harness setup (app restart fixture for crash recovery) dominates the estimate
warnings.rationale: if the crash-restart fixture proves unstable, checkpoint_and_split into per-gate subtasks (E1/E2/E3/E4 are already separate gates)

warnings.detail: verifies contracts C2-C6 end to end
warnings.rationale: inherent to E2E closure; it is the seam where all contracts meet
